The '''WESTAR-34''' was a small, silver [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] made from [[Dallorian alloy/Legends|dallorian alloy]].

==Description==
[[File:Jangos_holster_FF60.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jango Fett's holster belt.]]
The WESTAR-34 fired powerful bolts that were very effective at close range. The [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was designed specifically for sustained close-range use, utilizing its [[Dallorian alloy/Legends|dallorian]] construction to absorb more heat than a standard blaster. The pistol's expensive custom-made finish made it impervious to furnace fire. They were also small and compact enough to fit into a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]].

==History==
Favoring agility and precision over high capacity, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had a pair of WESTAR-34 blaster pistols<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> custom-made. Designed for brief but intense surprise attacks at close range, the pistols had weight-minimizing modifications and were made of an expensive Dallorian alloy which could withstand sustained-fire heating that would melt most ordinary blasters. During his [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|duel]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Jango lost one of his WESTARs to the [[Ocean/Legends|raging sea]]. He continued to use his remaining blaster against [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]]. Jango managed to finish off the [[Unidentified reek/Legends|Reek]] in the [[Petranaki arena|Execution Arena]] with one shot from his pistol. Jango then lost his second blaster to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Standard second|seconds]] before Mace [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated him]].

[[File:BobaTCW-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|A young Boba Fett wielding his custom-fit WESTAR-34 pistols]]
[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] also carried one of these when he was undercover as Korto Vos. After Jango Fett's death, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]] acquired two custom WESTAR-34s that Jango Fett had specially made to fit Boba. Other notable users of the WESTAR-34 were [[Fenn Shysa]] and [[Kal Skirata]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the animated segment of ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] uses a [[Sacros K-11|blaster]] that looks remarkably like the WESTAR-34 blaster pistol that his father uses in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']]. Whether this inspired the WESTAR-34's design is unknown.

In his first battle with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from ''Attack of the Clones'', [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] pistols sounded much like a regular blaster, but when he used them on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], they had a unique sound.<ref name="Episode II"/>

In the scenes where [[Zam Wesell]] is talking to Jango Fett and when she loads the kouhuns in the droid ASN-121 from ''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' Zam can be seen sporting a WESTAR-34 blaster pistol in her holster instead of the usual [[KYD-21 blaster pistol]] she uses in later scenes and keeps in the same holster.<ref name="Episode II" /> The first two scenes (with the WESTAR) were done during [[Wikipedia:Pick-up (filmmaking)|pick-ups]] shooting in [[March]] [[2001]] in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]], while the others scenes were from [[Wikipedia:Principal photography|principal photography]] in [[July]] [[2000]] in [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]]. [[Pablo Hidalgo]] hypothesized that the [[Wikipedia:Prop|prop]] of the KDY might have not been sent to the United Kingdom for the pick-ups.<ref name="Blusky">{{Bluesky|infinata.bsky.social|post/3mmkkoqklf22k|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2026-05-24|archivedate=20260524161354}}</ref>
